name: simplify
description: Reduce the reasoning required to understand and safely change code.

interface.shortDescription: Make code easier to understand and safely change.
interface.longDescription: Anchor engineering work on reducing accidental complexity, cognitive load, and change amplification rather than merely reducing line count.
defaultPrompt: Simplify this code by reducing its mental model.
Find the largest source of accidental complexity.
Make this change path obvious without changing behavior.
